quotes.text: Built entirely from public medical-education material with no protected health information
Because the MIMIC-IV Data Use Agreement restricts redistribution of patient-level clinical text
The released data files are fully synthetic and redistributable

parsed.rationale: The records are stated to be fully synthetic, generated by a named pipeline (Kimi 2.5 over board-question graphs). Governance for the real MIMIC-IV records used only in the realism study is described (DUA, de-identification mask repair), and data terms are stated separately from the code licence in the README.
